prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Personalize Your Companion", "Select unique personality traits and confirm your official adoption certificate.", "Traits: Playful, Calm, Curious"]
1: ["Signing in syncs your existing desktop pet collection across devices.", "Syncing Your Pet Sanctuary", "We checked your account and found your saved desktop pet profile."]
2: ["Preparing Desktop Pet Renderer", "Verifying screen overlay permissions and rendering companion graphics...", "Desktop Display: Ready"]
3: ["Welcome Your Companion Home", "Your desktop pet is now live on your screen.", "Desktop Pet Controls & Shortcuts", "Right-click your pet to open controls, or use Alt+P to toggle visibility anytime."]
4: ["Choose How You Want to Build Your Companion", "Select Instant Adoption for ready-to-play pets or Custom Creation to generate a pet from photos.", "Choose Your Path"]
5: ["Tip: Right-click your pet on desktop to give treats or start a chat!"]
6: ["Your pet customization and progress are securely saved to your account."]
7: ["Photo Upload Checklist for Best Results", "Use a clear photo with good lighting and a single clear subject.", "Clear subject face | Bright lighting | High resolution"]
8: ["Claim Your Welcome Pet Accessory!", "Your desktop companion is ready! Enjoy 100 bonus care points and a free starter hat.", "Welcome Gift Unlocked"]
9: ["Quick Setup: Takes less than 2 minutes to complete your pet onboarding."]
